purpose: Provide 6 provisional semantic families per A-D axis so a future 12-question bank could respect the user's <=2 per real semantic family limit, without asserting that 6 distinct families have been validated.
caveats: Every classification is provisional. Six names do not prove six different semantic judgments.
PROMISING_UNVERIFIED and HIGH_OVERLAP_RISK items are not approved score questions.
D-S5/D-S6 are currently paired research, not scored bank capacity.
If semantic families merge in editorial or respondent testing, the 12-bank coverage remains unfilled and must not be patched with paraphrases.
Existing 48 bank IDs are not reassigned by this artifact, to avoid hiding near-duplicates through fabricated family tags.
